faqModal.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
faqModal.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Agafari's wedding technology.
faqModal.q1: How do wedding guests receive their digital invitation pass?
faqModal.a1: The couple or organizer generates a unique shareable link (or sends via WhatsApp with 1-click). Guests open their link without needing to download any mobile app, view event details, and display their personal QR gate pass at the entrance.
faqModal.q2: How does the Anti-Passback Gate Scanner protect against uninvited crashers?
faqModal.a2: Each invitation QR code is tokenized and locked to a strict headcount quota (max_guests). When scanned by the gate security staff, the system registers the check-in count and prevents reused screenshot codes from entering.
faqModal.q3: Can the bride and groom moderate guest photos before they appear publicly?
faqModal.a3: Yes! All guest-uploaded photos, short videos, and wishes go into the private Bride & Groom Suite. Only approved content appears on the public site and TikTok feed, while rejected files stay safely saved in the private Rejected Vault until manually deleted.
faqModal.q4: Does Agafari support worldwide live streaming for Diaspora family members?
faqModal.a4: Absolutely. We deliver zero-latency ontime live streaming the event with interactive real-time floating heart and crown reactions so loved ones abroad can celebrate in real time.

privacyModal.title: Privacy Policy & Data Security
privacyModal.subtitle: Our strict commitments to couple and guest data protection.
privacyModal.p1Text: All photos and videos uploaded by wedding guests are stored in an encrypted vault accessible solely by the designated bride and groom.
privacyModal.p2Text: No guest submission is ever made public without explicit authorization from the couple.
privacyModal.p3Text: Gate pass scanning tokens and check-in tallies are encrypted and never shared with third-party advertising networks.
privacyModal.p4Text: The couple retains complete authority to purge rejected or historical wedding files from servers permanently.
